notes: Official Next.js 'with-supabase' starter example (the create-next-app --example with-supabase template), fetched from vercel/next.js monorepo path examples/with-supabase/ at canary HEAD; the examples/with-supabase/ path prefix was stripped so the case reads as a normal project root. Reviewed for Supabase/Next.js footguns and found none: only the publishable/anon key is referenced (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY), never a service_role key; .env.example ships placeholder values only (no committed credential); the protected route (app/protected/page.tsx) calls supabase.auth.getClaims() and redirect()s unauthenticated users; the proxy/middleware (proxy.ts -> lib/supabase/proxy.ts) redirects any non-public, unauthenticated request to /auth/login. This starter has no DB migrations/rules bundled, so there is no RLS surface to evaluate here. Included as a precision test case.
